# Error codes reference

Every error the API answers with (E82.3): `application/problem+json` whose `code`, `status` and `severity` come from the typed code and whose `type` points at the troubleshooting entry. Codes are stable; messages may carry placeholders the handler fills.

| Code | Status | Severity | Message | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `auth.assignment_not_found` | 404 | error | Assignment {0} does not exist. | [auth-assignment-not-found](../troubleshooting.md#auth-assignment-not-found) |
| `auth.built_in_role_read_only` | 409 | error | '{0}' is a built-in role; copy it to make an editable one. | [auth-built-in-role-read-only](../troubleshooting.md#auth-built-in-role-read-only) |
| `auth.disabled` | 403 | warning | The account is disabled. | [auth-disabled](../troubleshooting.md#auth-disabled) |
| `auth.forbidden` | 403 | warning | You are not allowed to do this. | [auth-forbidden](../troubleshooting.md#auth-forbidden) |
| `auth.integrity_failure` | 403 | error | The account cannot be verified; contact an administrator. | [auth-integrity-failure](../troubleshooting.md#auth-integrity-failure) |
| `auth.invalid_credentials` | 401 | warning | The user name or password is wrong. | [auth-invalid-credentials](../troubleshooting.md#auth-invalid-credentials) |
| `auth.invalid_role` | 400 | error | {0} | [auth-invalid-role](../troubleshooting.md#auth-invalid-role) |
| `auth.locked_out` | 423 | warning | The account is locked until {0}. | [auth-locked-out](../troubleshooting.md#auth-locked-out) |
| `auth.mapping_not_found` | 404 | error | Mapping {0} does not exist. | [auth-mapping-not-found](../troubleshooting.md#auth-mapping-not-found) |
| `auth.mapping_rejected` | 409 | error | {0} | [auth-mapping-rejected](../troubleshooting.md#auth-mapping-rejected) |
| `auth.not_signed_in` | 401 | info | Sign in first. | [auth-not-signed-in](../troubleshooting.md#auth-not-signed-in) |
| `auth.password_change_required` | 403 | warning | Change your password before continuing. | [auth-password-change-required](../troubleshooting.md#auth-password-change-required) |
| `auth.password_rejected` | 400 | error | {0} | [auth-password-rejected](../troubleshooting.md#auth-password-rejected) |
| `auth.provider_failed` | 502 | error | The identity provider could not complete the sign-in: {0} | [auth-provider-failed](../troubleshooting.md#auth-provider-failed) |
| `auth.provider_not_enabled` | 404 | warning | Identity provider '{0}' is not enabled. | [auth-provider-not-enabled](../troubleshooting.md#auth-provider-not-enabled) |
| `auth.role_name_taken` | 409 | error | A role named '{0}' already exists. | [auth-role-name-taken](../troubleshooting.md#auth-role-name-taken) |
| `auth.role_not_found` | 404 | error | Role {0} does not exist. | [auth-role-not-found](../troubleshooting.md#auth-role-not-found) |
| `auth.unavailable` | 503 | error | Sign-in is unavailable until the database is configured. | [auth-unavailable](../troubleshooting.md#auth-unavailable) |
| `auth.unknown_permission` | 400 | error | '{0}' is not a permission in the catalog. | [auth-unknown-permission](../troubleshooting.md#auth-unknown-permission) |
| `auth.user_not_found` | 404 | error | User {0} does not exist. | [auth-user-not-found](../troubleshooting.md#auth-user-not-found) |
| `concurrency.precondition_failed` | 412 | warning | The record changed since you read it; reload and try again. | [concurrency-precondition-failed](../troubleshooting.md#concurrency-precondition-failed) |
| `concurrency.precondition_required` | 428 | error | Send If-Match with the ETag you read. | [concurrency-precondition-required](../troubleshooting.md#concurrency-precondition-required) |
| `device.version_invalid` | 400 | error | '{0}' is not an app version. | [device-version-invalid](../troubleshooting.md#device-version-invalid) |
| `device.version_missing` | 400 | error | The device did not send its app version. | [device-version-missing](../troubleshooting.md#device-version-missing) |
| `device.version_too_old` | 426 | warning | App version {0} is below the minimum {1}; update the app. | [device-version-too-old](../troubleshooting.md#device-version-too-old) |
| `license.feature_not_licensed` | 403 | warning | '{0}' is not included in the {1} tier. | [license-feature-not-licensed](../troubleshooting.md#license-feature-not-licensed) |
| `license.key_not_found` | 404 | error | No installed key has the id '{0}'. | [license-key-not-found](../troubleshooting.md#license-key-not-found) |
| `license.key_rejected` | 400 | error | The key was refused: {0}. | [license-key-rejected](../troubleshooting.md#license-key-rejected) |
| `license.limit_reached` | 403 | warning | {0} | [license-limit-reached](../troubleshooting.md#license-limit-reached) |
| `logging.elevation_rejected` | 400 | error | The elevation was refused: {0}. | [logging-elevation-rejected](../troubleshooting.md#logging-elevation-rejected) |
| `settings.decided_elsewhere` | 409 | error | {0} is decided {1} (set by {2}); it cannot be configured at the {3} scope. | [settings-decided-elsewhere](../troubleshooting.md#settings-decided-elsewhere) |
| `settings.invalid_value` | 400 | error | {0} | [settings-invalid-value](../troubleshooting.md#settings-invalid-value) |
| `settings.mode_not_allowed` | 400 | error | {0} cannot be delegated {1} at the {2} scope. | [settings-mode-not-allowed](../troubleshooting.md#settings-mode-not-allowed) |
| `settings.scope_not_allowed` | 400 | error | {0} cannot be configured at the {1} scope. | [settings-scope-not-allowed](../troubleshooting.md#settings-scope-not-allowed) |
| `settings.store_unavailable` | 503 | error | Settings cannot be changed until a database is configured. | [settings-store-unavailable](../troubleshooting.md#settings-store-unavailable) |
| `settings.unknown_key` | 404 | error | '{0}' is not a registered setting. | [settings-unknown-key](../troubleshooting.md#settings-unknown-key) |
| `settings.unknown_scope` | 400 | error | '{0}' is not a setting scope (organization, site, zone, sku). | [settings-unknown-scope](../troubleshooting.md#settings-unknown-scope) |
